concerns.location: contracts/results_schema.schema.yaml vs data-model.md §4.3 and plan.md Phase 3 (Tb)
concerns.text: data-model.md §4.3 and plan task Tb require generalization_metrics.json to contain baseline_mape, relative_mape_reduction, and an SC-002 pass/fail (≥10% relative MAPE reduction), but results_schema.schema.yaml defines none of these fields (only mape_*, rmse_young, threshold, status) and has additionalProperties: false — the file the plan mandates cannot validate against its own contract. Add the baseline-comparison fields to the schema.

Schema describes threshold as 'Success threshold (e.g., 0.15)' with status based on that threshold, but the spec/plan's actual gate is SC-002 (≥10% relative MAPE reduction vs baseline), not an absolute MAPE threshold. The schema's PASS/FAIL semantics contradict the plan's gate; align the schema with the SC-002 criterion.

data-model.md §4.4 defines predictions.json with per-record absolute errors and per-record APE for all three properties; predictions.schema.yaml is a CSV-row-style schema with only error_young and mape_young (no shear/poisson errors, no APE field, additionalProperties: false). The plan's T018b output cannot satisfy both documents; reconcile them.

Neither contract is exercised by any plan task or data-model artifact: dataset.schema.yaml describes a 'filtered_materials.csv' that no task produces, and graph.schema.yaml describes a per-material PyG object not referenced by plan or data-model (graphs_v1.parquet is governed by dataset_schema.schema.yaml). Either wire them into a task or remove them to avoid dead contracts.

quickstart.md instructs running `python code/utils/verify_success_criteria.py --input data/results/generalization_metrics.json`, but this script appears in no plan task and no project-structure entry. Add a task/structure entry or remove the verification step.
